about: SCION 37 · Weighted Skinning: every asset in the film, where it came from, its rights, and the operation that made it.

assets.what: the dog: ONE closed triangle mesh (7,173 vertices, 14,344 triangles, Euler characteristic 2, no boundary) in its bind pose
assets.source: made here: build/mesh.py — a signed-distance sculpture (smooth union of round cones and ellipsoids laid on the rest skeleton) polygonised by surface nets at 1.75 cm, largest component kept, light Taubin smoothing

assets.what: 27 deforming bones (pelvis, spine, chest, neck1, neck2, head, two ears, three tail bones, four 4-bone legs) with bind matrices Trans(rest joint) and their inverses
assets.source: made here: build/rig.py dog_skeleton(); proportions judged against the archive dog's rig keys (kit/archive-dog/pose_agent_v8.json, read as numbers only)

assets.what: per-vertex bone weights, top 4 per vertex, normalised (max |sum-1| < 1e-15)
assets.source: computed here: build/mesh.py heat_weights() — Pinocchio bone heat (Baran & Popovic 2007): (L + M H) w_j = M H p_j on the cotangent Laplacian, H = 12/d^2 to the nearest bone; limb bones barred from the flank and back (stands in for the visibility test)

assets.what: the coat texture (1024x660, sepia) in the mesh's bind-pose side-projection UV space: film grain and fur of the archive dog, arranged by painted region masks (dark saddle, dark muzzle and ear backs, lighter socks); the eye, nose and lip line painted on top
assets.source: paeleo/handmade/kit/archive-dog/frames f000..f048 (every second frame), masked by kit/archive-dog/masks.json (SAM polygons, eroded 3 px): 8,969 patches of 10x10 px of the dog's own pixels, upscaled x3.2 and scattered with feathered edges (seed 37). Source film: Amateur Film New Jersey C, Home Movies collection, Internet Archive, https://archive.org/details/NewJerseyC (via movingimagearchive.com clip 2fdacde1-8a23-58e1-b905-5407385bd039)
assets.rights: public domain (kit source.json: rights_statement public_domain); painted marks made here
assets.operation: mask, crop (patches), quilt, region-mask painting, sepia grade; eye/nose drawn

assets.what: the person: one closed skinned mesh (4,272 vertices, genus 0) with 19 deforming bones, faceless (a plain head with a dark cap of hair), wool coat, trousers; posed by keyed clips (stand, reach, step aside, sit, the low hand)
assets.source: made here: build/mesh.py person_sdf + heat weights; build/perform.py person_track
assets.rights: made here; no real person or face

assets.what: the porch deck and steps, the clapboard house front with doorway, sill and lit window, the green door (hinged, opens inward), the room (floor, walls, rug, picture, lamp), the crate; the dusk sky with a tree line and the yard
assets.source: made here: build/world.py (subdivided quads, procedural materials per pixel in build/render.py), sky and yard computed per ray
assets.operation: modelled in code, rasterized, procedurally shaded

assets.what: all sound: crickets and air (room tone), the person's voice ('Come here.' x2, 'It's all right.' x2 soft, 'Come in.' soft) from a source-filter formant synthesizer, door creak, the room's clock once the door is open, the dog's claws at every gait touch-down, body settling, a sigh, the tail knocking the sill
assets.source: made here: build/sound.py (numpy/scipy synthesis); no recordings

assets.what: Big Shoulders Display, Literata, JetBrains Mono for the cards and the spoken-word subtitles
assets.rights: SIL Open Font License (as shipped with the repo's tools)

assets.what: the dog's decision trace (32 s, 768 frames) that drives every channel of the performance

not_used: no Quick, Draw! drawings, no found-frames shots, no archive-door frames, no web images, no generated images
